SOC2 & ISO 27001 compliance, priority support with SLAs, daily backups retained 14 days.

addOns.en: Image transformations $5 per 1,000 origin images beyond 100 free.

cautions.en: Pro plan includes only $10/month of compute credit; a larger compute instance is billed as an add-on on top of the $25 base.
MAU, disk, egress and storage overages beyond the Pro plan's included amounts are billed per unit.

capabilities.en: All-in-one backend built on Postgres: database, authentication, storage, auto-generated REST/GraphQL APIs and realtime subscriptions.
Open source, positioned as a Firebase alternative with a fully relational Postgres database underneath.
Free plan is generous enough to build and test a full project before paying, with 50,000 MAUs included.

limitations.en: Free project pauses automatically after one week of inactivity, requiring manual restart.
Compute, storage, egress and MAU overages on Pro are all separately metered, making cost less predictable than a flat subscription.

reason.en: The main competitor Supabase positions itself against, NoSQL-based rather than Postgres.
Serverless Postgres alternative, without the auth/storage/realtime layer Supabase bundles.

unknowns: Exact per-unit overage rates for compute credits beyond the $10 included on Pro were not itemized in detail on the fetched page.
